reservation.ordering: Persist/fsync reservation before creating destination; create empty root, pin and persist its identity, then permit payload bytes. Represent crash before identity attachment.
reservation.content: IDs, locators, hashes only; no text/audio/vectors.

seams.snapshot_closed_state: Reserve before destination.mkdir/_copy. Register SDK work before copytree and constructor. Publish preparation after realclose/finalsourcecheck/verifiedmanifest.
seams.materialize_derived_state: Reserve before _INCOMPLETE/_clone_latest. Pass operation into SDK path; publish preparation after actualcloses before enabling ownedtargets.

rules: PREPARED is not CLEANED. Persist entry before dispatch and return only after actual return.
Retain actual handles. Constructor/close/persistence uncertainty stays UNKNOWN; PID death/freeflock/timeout/kill never ACK.
Recovery reads external records without RAM/local incomplete files. New operation requires current authority and exact identity.
Cleanup claim binds current HEAD/lease/scope/revision. Completion requires implemented owner, actual return and physical verification; otherwise blocked/pending.
Pre-existing copies require honest retrospective registration, never a claim of before-first-byte registration. Legacy HEAD migration is separate.

minimum_tests: Clone failure leaves durable owner/extents before local record.
SDK ctor/close uncertainty retains files and blocks.
Cleanup cancellation retains owned work until actual return without premature ACK.
